6152.text_preview: clear search ✕ SensePFASt 2026 Water connects all living organisms. So does the pollution by stable molecules like PFAS. PFAS come in many shapes and sizes, are extremely persistent and incorporated in a lot of everyday products. While PFAS improve our life in different ways, they also pose a silent threat. They accumulate in water, the environment and, ultimately, our bodies. This is a problem. PFAS weaken our immune responses, disrupt our hormone systems and can cause cancer. Water treatment facilities bear the responsibility to act. But it's hard to eliminate a threat you cannot see. This is SensePFASt: A yeast based biosensor that makes the invisible visible. 6090.title: | BOKU-Vienna - iGEM 2026
6090.text_preview: Do you know Reinhardt? Chlamydomonas reinhardtii is a single-celled green microalga – tiny, fast-growing and one of biology's favourite model organisms. Reinhardt is rich in protein and already makes the precursors of vitamin C and folate (vitamin B9). We want to help it make more. Integrated Human Practices → Microalgae need little more than water, light and simple nutrients, which makes them a promising, accessible food source. We concentrate on vitamin C and folate – both essential for a healthy body and a strong immune system. We overexpress key enzymes: GGP for vitamin C, and GTPCHI with ADCS for folate – comparing Reinhardt's own genes with homologs from tomato. A proof of concept for a sustainable, vitamin-enriched microalga – connecting synthetic biology with food security and the UN SDGs. ▲

Cells in the body share many of the same surface markers, so a tool that targets just one can also reach healthy cells . Getting the editor only to the right cells is still an open challenge. 02 — Our system Two phages, one decision Phaged-it uses two M13 bacteriophages engineered to bind human cells. One, targeted to EGFR , carries a CRISPR base editor . The other, targeted to FRα , carries the guide RNA . Neither works alone: editing happens only in a cell that both phages reach . 03 — Why together An AND-gate for gene editing A single marker is not specific enough, two markers are much more selective . 6204.text_preview: Drug testing is limited by inaccurate models Drug discovery and screening rely on models that can predict how new treatments will work before these are tested on human patients. One of the biggest challenges is finding a model that closely reflects human biology while remaining practical for research [ 3 ]. For many years, researchers have mainly relied on two-dimensional (2D) cell cultures and animal models. Although these models have contributed greatly to biomedical research, neither fully capture the complexity of human tissues [ 1 ]. In recent years, organoids have emerged as a promising alternative. They carry their own genome, the mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA). 1 out of 5000 people live with a mitochondrial disease. [1] Mutations in mitochondrial DNA can disrupt energy production, leaving high-demand tissues such as the brain, heart and muscles particularly vulnerable. rules_2026.gold_requirements: Bronze and Silver first; select exactly 3 for Gold consideration, at least 1 General Bio Engineering and at least 1 Specialization, third from either. All three must satisfy the performance standard. Winning a Special Award is not necessary for Gold. Fewer than 3 can be selected but does not qualify for Gold.
rules_2026.gold_scoring_2026: Judges do not cast a separate Gold vote; each selected award rubric score is converted to yes/no against a performance standard, then the criterion is resolved by the stated voting procedure. The public numeric performance cutoff is not provided.
rules_2026.special_winner_rule: Highest relevant ballot score within the applicable competition group, subject to minimum performance; tied highest teams all win.

section_rule_uncertainty.observed_on_special_page: The Special Awards page independently says collegiate sections receive separate awards only with at least 10 teams and refers to the Village rules. The surrounding paragraph discusses each Special Award.
section_rule_uncertainty.short_exact_quote: each collegiate section (undergraduate and overgraduate) receives its own award only if it has at least 10 teams
section_rule_uncertainty.handbook_comparison: The 2026 handbook page 27 states the 10-per-section criterion explicitly for Village Awards; its Special Awards paragraph only states highest average score from the relevant rubric category.
section_rule_uncertainty.unresolved_denominator: The Special Awards webpage does not explicitly define whether its 10-team denominator is the number selecting that individual award or a wider section population. No definitive interpretation is imposed here. It is not justified to use same-village counts as a Special Award pool.
section_rule_uncertainty.consequence: Use verified Overgrad applicants as the primary comparison and Undergrad as a possible combined-pool scenario. Do not announce that 7 observed Hardware applicants necessarily means a combined award, or that 75 roster records proves separate awards. Official clarification or a published award-pool allocation is needed.

scope_notes: Official roster and anonymous submission snapshot cover 74 non-example accepted Overgrad entries, including NTHU. 60 public submitted forms, 14 API 404. These are observations, not final eligible candidate totals.
All 74 homepage HTTP requests returned 200; 37 had limited static text/JS shells. This is connectivity coverage, not 74 complete scientific reviews or proof all uploads were complete.

Technical targeted review covered 16 peer teams including 7 observed Hardware entrants and 8 observed Measurement entrants, overlapping. Model focused on two strong submitted peers plus project context, not all 31. Social review covered 10 OG teams plus 3 sustainability peers; direct submitted samples: Education4, iHP7, Entrepreneurship2.

Primary comparison is Overgrad. Special Awards split wording has an unresolved denominator; do not assume Hardware must combine or must stay separate. Undergrad NCKU/EPFL examples are supplementary possible-combined-pool context.
Different project F1, R2, correlation, sample definitions and cost scopes cannot be ranked against each other as identical metrics.
Published team narratives and plots were examined; no new laboratory replication, full competitor data audit or complete source-code execution was performed.

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 5個培養run、TB33/LB29個光度計對照；生長觸發誘導及自動試劑加入。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 校正同時用了這些run，並非完全獨立驗證；pH整機整合未完成。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 生物用途和需求到實作比NTHU更集中，是強直接對手。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 六井reader、0–200μM標準液R²=.979、三次讀取約1%變異；GFP E.coli/WT為2.76倍。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 各一tube的技術重讀；尚非獨立生物複本，完整boat仍未驗證。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: NTHU串擾分析較深入，對方簡單生物陽性／陰性展示較清楚。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 37°C控制、約CAD204一pump版；4h E.coli生長由外部光度計確認。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 內建OD絕對值與跨run校正仍失準；不是96台並行已驗證。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 完整生物用途與反覆工程改動強，但不是所有功能都勝過NTHU。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 2026厭氧艙、氧氣monitor及搖床；最新傳動報告運轉超過兩週。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 0.5%氧氣顯示不能驗證嚴格厭氧；缺量化漏氣、轉速和負載驗證。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: NTHU光學量化較深；不能用該隊2025冠軍替2026加分。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: BREC已建；2h加熱測試；教育有礦區高中、DNA活動、Sankofa/Palaver可重用工具。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 生長只有前後濁度照片，不是金回收驗證；教育無充分量化前後測。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 硬體NTHU量化較強；教育屬可競爭的相近層級。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 泵25cycles中20完成、5stalls，完成者CV8.3%；多模組測試。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 無完整整合MAGE驗證；光學raw pairs/fit欠齊、清潔正控未成功。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: NTHU量測分析較完整，不能只看模組數。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 目前公開硬體頁僅簡短Arduino prototype描述。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 仍有placeholder文字；濕實驗Cas訊號不等於reader效能。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 目前公開硬體證據較少，不推論其未公開工作。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: MitoPEia以2815 designs/1617 components、grouped五折和外部scaffold資料測試，參與5個靶點選擇。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 不等於成功粒線體editing；教育部分為自評，HP仍有placeholder consultation notes。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 模型問題聚焦且連到設計；教育有前次回饋→後次課程的清楚改進。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: WT擬合後不refit預測兩folate lines，final biomass誤差−8.5%/+1.2%。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 維他命C 4.5倍只是落在1–10倍寬預測帶，非精準預測。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 比NTHU更清楚呈現獨立條件預測；不是用R²/F1跨題比較。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 五介質fluoride校正、10 blanks、各濃度5技術複本、LOD/LOQ/干擾；需求收斂到RO濃縮液處理。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 部分PFAS結果低於LOD，商業濾材壽命和收入仍是估算。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 量測通用性與需求—方法—成本的連結更成熟。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: LAMP近緣種、qPCR比較、河湖加標及便攜incubator實際擴增；回饋導致引子與硬體改動。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: synthetic DNA加標不等於自然感染場域驗證；頁面部分倍數敘述與數字不一致。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 方法可轉移性及stakeholder改動鏈較強。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: OMV三生物分離複本及BCA/SEM/HIM/DLS/zeta多方法；專家需求進入反應器設計。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 粒子身分/異質性仍有限；kill switch等為計畫。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 比NTHU多生物複本，但不是方法多就自動高分。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 釐清市鎮申請、州政府付款、工程方選方案；實際支出與未來成本區分。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 未證明一致土壤碳酸鹽或強度改善；無實際商業訂單。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 誰受益、誰付款、誰實施比NTHU更明確。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: Ara h1 aptamer結合及磁珠/光學元件定性測試。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 目前公開定量證據較少。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 13名患者、176人問卷；需求導致對象和體外處理方案收斂。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: Measurement頁為Content to follow，但其他頁有實驗；不等於無研究。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: iHP比NTHU需求到設計的證據鏈更完整。

targeted_peer_reviews.limits: Measurement/Results目前保留模板指示，不能判全隊未做。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 該專頁目前不足支持強量測競爭判斷。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 生活類比、兒童桌遊現場修規則、離線教材；149人問卷及11攤商調查。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: 未充分量化教育學習增益；完整條帶不是已完成產品。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 教育與NTHU相近；家庭需要到顏色讀值的連結較清楚。

targeted_peer_reviews.observed: 漂移受害農民與農學專家促成由降解轉檢測，定位篩檢和後續確認。
targeted_peer_reviews.limits: MOOC700+註冊/250+完課含多年累積，不能全算2026新增。
targeted_peer_reviews.comparison: 農村服務與正式確認可並存，是NTHU應用定位的好比較。
